newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - December 9.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - December 9.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Monday. Reuter has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Top watchdog agency Control Yuan finishes preliminary investigation on military car explosion in which 12 killed or injured.
Justice ministry intensifies crackdown on gangster infiltration of religion.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Police searching for silver-coloured BMW car as investigation continues into slaying of Taoyuan county magistrate and seven others.
Taiwan fails to protect women's rights adequately, study says.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Chinese Petroleum Corp to finalise price adjustments today (Monday).
Taiwan sees low wage increases due to sluggish economy.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Authorities arrest Taiwanese owner of two information product plants in Germany.
Interest rates will not fall further before year end.
LIBERTY TIMES - Interference from communist China forces Taiwan Foreign Minister John Chang to cut short trip in Europe.
Navy completes research and development for new missile-carrying speed boats.
